covers.text: Accessibility, security headers, usability and Core Web Vitals, readability, and whether AI tools and search engines can read the site. Every page, against 103 open standards.

cost.text: Public. $50 to $1,000 a month, by number of domains and page scans. No quote needed.

public.text: Public by default. Every scanned domain has a scorecard anyone can open, and your team's full dashboard is private to your account.

alongside.text: No. ScanGov runs next to whatever you use today and covers checks most suites leave out.

proves.text: A dated history of every score change, a public scorecard, and a trend line for every indicator.

whole-site.text: Every page in your sitemap, on a schedule, with on-demand rescans.

history.text: Pulse trend lines and a dated changelog for every indicator.

scoped-views.text: Filters by site, topic, and URL path, with members attached.

sso.text: Okta through OpenID Connect (OIDC) on Business and Enterprise plans. Microsoft Entra ID is not supported yet.

auth-pages.text: No. ScanGov scans public pages only.

ci.text: A free GitHub Action audits your site on every deploy.

issue-tracker.text: GitHub integration, pre-filled issue reports, and CSV, JSON, or Markdown export.

public-scorecard.text: A public scorecard for every domain and rankings against peers on scangov.org.

open-standards.text: 103 published standards, each with guidance on how to fix it.

public-pricing.text: Four plans from $50 a month. Pay and start scanning in minutes.

a11y-automated.text: Automated WCAG checks on every page, ranked by impact in the tasklist.

a11y-pdf.text: PDF checks are included in the scan.

a11y-video.text: Captions on page videos and titles on embedded players.

bot-robots.text: Robots.txt, sitemap, canonical tags, and schema on every page.

bot-render.text: Reports whether a crawler that does not run JavaScript sees your content.

bot-ai.text: Checks whether good bots, including AI crawlers, can reach the site.

sec-headers.text: HTTPS, HSTS, Content Security Policy (CSP), and X-Content-Type-Options on every page.

sec-tld.text: Flags government sites not on a .gov domain.

use-cwv-lab.text: Lab Core Web Vitals on every page, scored against the standards.

use-cwv-field.text: No. ScanGov reports lab data only.

use-meta.text: Titles, descriptions, viewport, and social sharing tags on every page.

read-grade.text: Automated Readability Index and Flesch-Kincaid on every page.

read-target.text: Set a reading level target per site.

concerns.compliance: Every page, every indicator, on a schedule, with a dated record of what changed and when.
concerns.budget: Published prices from $50 a month. The top plan is $12,000 a year.
concerns.scrutiny: A public scorecard for every domain, so you see your grade before anyone else does.
concerns.vendor: A neutral, public, monthly record you can write into a contract and check without asking the vendor.
